title: Documents
description: First-class formal documents — edit envelope metadata and body together, fully inside the app.
listEmptyHint: Create a formal document to get started.
folderHint: e.g. minutes — leave empty for the top level
conflictDescription: This document was changed outside the app since you opened it ({{updated}}). Reloading discards your edits.
conflictOverwriteHint: Ignores the external change and overwrites it with your edits — an explicit decision that cannot be undone.
moveHint: Enter the new path keeping the same extension. e.g. subfolder/new-name.html
legacyReadOnly: Read-only — this document cannot be edited
duplicateIds: Multiple documents share the same id — check the conflicting paths below.
